name: comp-508

frames.best_why: A complete range from 14 November to 9 December with both months banded and no cursor.
frames.render_note: Calendar sits tiny in the centre of a large empty stage, so the day numbers are very small.

tagline: Two stacked month grids for choosing a range across months.
summary: One bordered dark panel holding November and December one above the other, each with its own weekday row. A single range runs from a day in the first month to a day in the second, both ends circled in white.
appearance: A narrow black panel with two month blocks divided by a faint gap: each has a centred month name, a row of two-letter weekdays and five or six rows of day numbers. Days in the range sit in grey cells and the two ends are solid white circles.
behaviour: Pressing a day starts the range and moving into the next month previews the span; a second press fixes the end, and the arrows move both months together. The frames move the end from 9 December to 23 and back to 10.
demo_content: November and December 2026, with a range from 14 November to 9 December.
search_phrases: two months side by side for a date range
calendar showing november and december at once
pick a range across two months
booking calendar with two month view
date range that spans a month boundary
stacked month calendars in one box
choose start in one month end in the next
use_when: Ranges regularly cross a month boundary, so seeing two months saves arrow clicks.
avoid_when: The months stack in one narrow column, so the panel grows tall and the type becomes tiny.
customise: The opening range of today plus twenty-five days and the caption link sit in the file; month count, paged navigation and outside days come from the shared calendar.
weight_why: Two month grids of plain date buttons; nothing animates.

a11y.note: Days are buttons in labelled grids and month changes are announced politely, but nothing explains the two-click range rule.

issues: The calendar renders very small in a wide empty stage, so day numbers are hard to read.
The two months stack vertically rather than sitting side by side.
The caption credits the calendar library instead of describing the range.
polish_why: Clean range band across two months, but the tiny scale and mostly empty stage weaken it.
title: Two Month Range Calendar
